finalists.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence from both CT-guided lung biopsy and VATS wedge resection, showing large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis and infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm.

finalists.label: Pneumonia
finalists.why: This candidate has for evidence from bilateral vesicular breathing with diffuse rhonchi on lung auscultation and CT Chest showing superimposed pneumonia.

finalists.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
finalists.why: This candidate has for evidence from infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm, mixed inflammatory infiltrate, marked nuclear pleomorphism with atypical mitotic figures, vascular involvement, and areas of parenchymal necrosis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most decisive findings, including large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis and infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm, which are specific to this diagnosis.
